changelog:
- Initial release of the "sending-emails" skill for Mailtrap email delivery integration and troubleshooting.
- Provides clear guidance on choosing between Email API (REST), SMTP, SDKs, or plugins for sending email.
- Explains streams (Transactional, Bulk), batch sending, and campaigns to help pick the right path.
- Includes quick reference tables for API endpoints, SMTP settings, authentication, rate limits, and JSON examples.
- Lists related skills and when not to use this guide (e.g., sandbox/testing-only, webhooks, UI setup).
summary: Use when integrating, configuring, or troubleshooting Mailtrap live email sending (Email API or SMTP). Use when wiring outbound mail from an application or choosing how to send.
